summary: The filing is a Form 6-K submitted by Energys Group Ltd reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on June 22, 2026. The meeting included routine matters: election of five directors (Kevin Cox, Michael Lau, Peter Walder, Bin You Wang, Yingying Duan) and ratification of WWC, P.C. as the independent auditor for fiscal year ending June 30, 2026. There are no special-situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, tender offers, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, or management changes beyond normal director elections. This is a routine current report of an AGM with no transformative corporate action.
